overview: Black plays the waiting move 2...h6, perhaps to stop Bg5 or Ng5, before choosing a Sicilian set-up. White normally plays 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 into an Open Sicilian a tempo up. I am unsure of the main line; tags follow the move order.

white_ideas.idea: Play 3.d4 cxd4 4.Nxd4 and use the extra tempo
Go for a Maroczy-style bind or quick development

black_ideas.idea: Transpose to a Scheveningen or Najdorf-type set-up
Use ...h6 to take g5 away from White

typical_structures.structure: Open Sicilian with the half-open c-file for Black

character.notes: Normal Sicilian tension with a spare Black move, so neither side is forced into extremes.

soundness.notes: ...h6 is a wasted tempo but not a real flaw.

structure.notes: After d4 cxd4 Nxd4 it is a standard Sicilian with a half-open c-file.

approach.notes: Strong players seldom play ...h6 here and it is chosen for surprise.

level.notes: The plans are Sicilian ones, so Intermediate.
